title: [spec-gap][R-02AT-031] Root-switch anti-flap (<=1 per superframe) and DRIFTING different-root stratum gate absent in all stacks (spec 02a-tdma.md:78-79)
description: Two MUSTs from spec/02a-tdma.md:69-79 with no implementation. (1) :78 A SYNCED node seeing a higher-stratum beacon SHOULD re-evaluate root preference but MUST NOT switch roots more than once per superframe to prevent flapping. Classification: not-implemented. No once-per-superframe rate limiter exists in any stack (no last_root_switch / min_interval / anti-flap construct). Nearest mechanism is the 3-superframe holdoff before committing a root change — python slot_coordination.py:50 (HOLDOFF_SUPERFRAMES=3) and :417-421, rust lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:840 and :1117-1121 — which is a different rule, is absent in C entirely (no HOLDOFF symbol in lichen/subsys), and whose expiry is not wired to rejoin (b7z9.25.2 closed the py/rust signal only). (2) :79 While DRIFTING, a node MUST NOT adopt beacons from a different root unless the beacon stratum is lower (better); at equal stratum the node MUST remain with its current root. Classification: not-implemented. DRIFTING + valid beacon transitions unconditionally in every stack: C tdma.c:242-245 (DRIFTING+VALID_BEACON->ACQUIRING, no root identity or stratum check), python timing/tdma_fsm.py:36-37, rust lichen-core/src/desync.rs:304-309 (CcpFSM on_beacon); MultiRootState/select_root never consult desync/sync state (multi_instance.rs:1009-1015, slot_coordination.py:307-313). python/tests/test_multi_root_rejoin.py pins overlap+rejoin but neither rule. Suggested placement: add a last_root_switch superframe stamp + rate limiter to MultiRootState (py slot_coordination.py, rust multi_instance.rs) and port the holdoff to C; gate different-root beacon adoption in DRIFTING/DESYNCED on beacon stratum < current root stratum; extend test_multi_root_rejoin.py and ccp16-desync consumers. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-09-09 (docs/spec-coverage/02a-tdma.md R-02AT-031/032).
